news.title: News
news.content:
Imagine you have to use an application to register your facial attendance. First, the system shows you a box on the screen so you know exactly where to place your face. As you adjust, it turns green to let you know you're ready.

It's important to be in a place with good lighting. Once your face looks good, the system asks for a small gesture, like blinking or moving your head a little, to make sure it's not a photo or something fake.

The best part is that the scan doesn't take long, just about two or three seconds, and immediately a clear message appears on the screen telling you whether the attendance was registered or if there was any problem. Everything is designed to be quick and simple: open the app, press the button to go to the Facial Scanning section, position yourself in the box, blink, and within seconds your attendance is saved.
